description: A grid of frames across the project (or between from and to), each stamped with its time. The quickest way to review an edit. Give times to see exact moments instead (both sides of every cut, say); give clip to see one clip alone across its length.

clip.description: A clip id from get_project (or part of its name): show that clip alone

project.description: Project id from list_projects or create_project

times.description: Exact times in seconds to show, instead of from / to / count
